results.summary: This design implements a 256-byte ROM that stores information about the Tiny Tapeout chip, including the shuttle name and commit hash. The first 16 bytes are 7-segment encoded and can be displayed on the on-board 7-segment display by holding reset low and toggling the clock, or by setting the address with DIP switches. The ROM is 8-bit wide and 256 bytes long. It is intended for educational purposes to demonstrate ROM access and display.

This design implements a multiply-accumulate (MAC) unit for the 16-bit DLFloat data type, intended for deep learning applications. It performs multiply and accumulate operations, which are fundamental to neural network inference. The design is implemented in Verilog and is suitable for educational or research purposes. It demonstrates a key building block for machine learning hardware.

This design is a trial implementation of a lightweight all-digital true random number generator based on ring oscillators. It outputs random data via a UART serial interface, and also provides ring oscillator and random generator outputs for observation. The design is intended for testing and evaluation of TRNG concepts. It uses ring oscillators to generate entropy.

This design handles 16 LED inputs, 16 switch outputs, 12 seven-segment display inputs, and 5 button outputs, communicating via UART RX and TX on the bidirectional PMOD bus. It is intended for educational purposes to demonstrate I/O handling and display control. The design uses a 7-segment display and LEDs for output, and switches and buttons for input. It is implemented in Verilog and targets the Tiny Tapeout platform.

This design implements an audio effect that processes an audio input signal and produces an output with a delay effect. It uses an I2S interface for audio input and output, and includes a delay line for the effect. The design is intended for audio processing applications. It is implemented in Verilog and targets the Tiny Tapeout platform.

This design is a music synthesizer that generates tones and melodies. It uses a multiplier and ALU for note generation, and includes memory for storing sequences. The design is intended for music generation and playback. It is implemented in Verilog and targets the Tiny Tapeout platform.

This design generates a VGA video signal with a test pattern. It includes a VGA interface and outputs video, graphics, and PWM signals. The design is intended for testing and demonstration of VGA output. It is implemented in Verilog and targets the Tiny Tapeout platform.

This design implements a counter that can be displayed on a 7-segment display. It includes a clock generator and is intended for educational purposes. The design is simple and demonstrates basic counting and display. It is implemented in Verilog and targets the Tiny Tapeout platform.

This design is a factory test structure that includes a counter and GPIO interface. It is intended for testing the chip's functionality. The design includes a current mirror for analog testing. It is implemented in Verilog and targets the Tiny Tapeout platform.

This design has been validated on fabricated silicon and works as expected. It is a simple design that demonstrates the functionality of the Tiny Tapeout chip. The design is intended for educational purposes. It is implemented in Verilog and targets the Tiny Tapeout platform.
